Publish.LongDescription:
# Skylines Maps
Tired of the useless traffic infoview we had to deal with since the launch of CS2? This mod provides a live traffic congestion infoview that resembles real life navigation apps
The mod adds a new layer to the vanilla Traffic infoview, showing the actual live congestion on the roads just like in CS:1
## Features
- Live Congestion mode inside the existing Traffic infoview - Traffic flow graph is now useful and reflect the live congestion percentage every 15 ingame minutes. - City wide live congestion readout under the graph - Different colour palettes - Ability to adjust values and fine tine tune how traffic gets decided to be congested - Keyboard shortcut to open the traffic infoview directly, Ctrl+T by default
## Savegame Combaitibility
The mod is safe to remove any time to restoree the vanilla implementation. I have tested the mod with almost 250 other mods and have not encountered any compatibility issues. If you do encounter any, please feel free to write to me on pdx forums or in the modding discord.

The AI was used as a tool to assist in the development process, but the final product is a result of human creativity and effort.
Publish.ChangeLog:
- The city wide traffic percentage is now calculated using road importance, higher laned roads have a bigger effect on the percentage. Which should improve the abnormally high traffic percentages shown before and show a more accurate reflection.
- Live traffic flow now feeds the vanilla traffic flow graph (Will need a full 24 ingame hour simulation to populate the graph).
